sql:
SELECT
  d.company_name,
  COUNT(f.posting_key) AS open_remote_us_listings
FROM fct_posting AS f
JOIN dim_company AS d
  ON f.company_key = d.company_key
WHERE
  f.is_open AND f.remote_us
GROUP BY
  d.company_name
ORDER BY
  open_remote_us_listings DESC
LIMIT 3;
